note: Low / likely / high scenarios. Every value is a PLACEHOLDER set by judgement. fidelity_offset is added to every zone's natural fidelity (more natural ground = less earthwork). prices picks each unit cost's low, price or high; items with no range use price × (1 + no_range_spread). assumed_quantity_factor scales hole quantities tagged assumed (tee pads, drainage, irrigation heads, undrawn paths). contingency replaces the project value when set (5-15% is the commonly cited range).
